content: The role of PassThroughSwConnector PassThrough- SwConnector can be taken to connect PortPrototype s owned by the same Com- positionSwComponentType . In other words, PassThroughSwConnector creates a bypass inside a CompositionSwComponentType from the requiredOuterPort to the providedOuterPort (or vice versa) without involving SwComponentProto- type s.
